rules.names: The security-event hook (Node onSecurityEvent, Python on_security_event, PHP onSecurityEvent) is called only with these types, and every event has exactly the fields listed: no other, none missing (a value can be null where it is unknown, such as operationId outside the API methods). An event never carries a secret, an xpub or an address.
rules.order: The hook is called before the error is thrown; an exception from the hook is swallowed so it can never hide the error.
rules.alarm: alarm: an error follows (the answer is refused). The others are information.
rules.logging: With no hook, every event is logged once at warning level as "Vaultody security event: " followed by its JSON (compact, keys in the catalogue's order, "/" and non-ASCII unescaped); with a hook, the hook gets it and nothing is logged. A hook that raises is logged once at warning level as "the security event hook raised on <type>; the call still fails or continues as it would". unsigned_response_accepted also has its own warning, hook or not.
rules.results: addressCheck and vaultKeyResult are the entries of the per-answer results (Node meta.addressChecks / meta.vaultKeys, Python meta.address_checks / meta.vault_keys, PHP meta->addressChecks / meta->vaultKeys): objects with exactly these keys in every language; only the container's name follows the language's casing.

events.when: when-present mode, before the latch: the first unsigned response a client accepts (once per client); one warning is logged after it

the first answer from an origin that carries any of the four response-signature headers, whether it verifies or not (rootId null when it does not; raised before its error): unsigned responses are refused from then on (response-mode-v1.json)
a response fails its signature check (reason: missing, invalid, expired, unknown_root, request_unbound, unsupported_version, ...); ResponseVerificationError follows and it is never retried
a vault is pinned for the first time (status verified or unverified)
an unverified pin is confirmed by a signed vault list (status verified)
a vault list differs from a pin; alarms as in VaultKeyChangedError; VaultKeyChangedError follows
an address in an answer can't be accepted (code as in AddressVerificationError: mismatch, unsupported, unknown_vault, ...); AddressVerificationError follows

addressCodes.when: the address does not derive from the vault's pinned xpub; addAssetToVaultAccount answers another address than the one sent; an item that carries its derivation path names another blockchain than the one asked for

an item that carries its derivation path names another network than the one asked for (generateDepositAddress), or the network does not go with the vault type (mainnet with a main vault, any other with a test vault)
an answer item without an address, or with path fields that can't be read
the chain of an address with its path is not given, or is not one the SDK can derive
the vault of the answer is in neither vault list

with requireAddressPaths on (the default once the derivation paths are public), generateDepositAddress answers an address without accountIndex, isChange and addressIndex for a vault with MPC keys, on a chain the SDK can derive (vault-key-pins-v1.json addressChecks)
